title: Methods of test for polyvinyl chloride boots, Part 6: Determination of tensile strength and elongation at break
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12240 (PART 6)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Methods of test for polyvinyl chloride boots, Part 6: Determination of tensile strength and elongation at break.
clause_3_terminology: Methods of test for polyvinyl chloride boots
Part 6: Determination of tensile strength and elongation at break

mechanical_properties: maximum strength of the piece will not be developed.
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
